question: Who is known as the Prince of Patriots?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Subhash Chandra Bose**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Mahatma Gandhi called Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose the "Prince among Patriots" after Bose's death.
 
• Gandhi made this statement about Bose's ability to unite men and women from all regions and religions of India in the Indian National Army. 
 
• He was a celebrated Indian freedom fighter.
 
• He wanted India to gain independence as soon as possible, and he believed that violent resistance was the only way to oust the imperialist rule.
 
• Bose and Gandhi had different ideologies, but Bose admired Gandhi and called him "The Father of Our Nation" in a radio broadcast

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Bhagat Singh
 
 
• A freedom fighter who lived from 1907 to 1931 
 
 
 
• Subhash Chandra Bose
 
 
• A freedom fighter who lived from 1897 to 1945 
 
 
 
• Vallabhbhai Patel
 
 
• A lawyer and political leader who served as India's first Deputy Prime Minister and Home Minister from 1947 to 1950. He was also known as "Sardar". 
 
 
 
• Rajendra Prasad
 
 
• A freedom fighter, jurist, parliamentarian, and administrator who lived from 1884 to 1963. He was a follower of Mahatma Gandhi.
